name: Entity ESP
description: Clean debug boxes for players, hostile mobs and non-hostile mobs.

name: Storage ESP

name: Tracers

name: Fullbright
description: Lift world lighting for clearer exploration.

name: Coordinates
description: Show position and dimension in your HUD.

name: Crosshair

name: Particles

name: Interface

name: Skybox

name: Atmosphere
description: Cinematic bloom and color grading. Skybox controls the sky.

name: Server Privacy

name: HUD Studio
description: Choose your menu, appearance and HUD widget layout.

name: Watermark
description: Your selected logo and version badge.

name: Active Modules

name: FPS
description: Current client frames per second.

name: Ping

name: Speed HUD

name: Armor

name: Potion Effects

name: Target HUD

name: Inventory Preview
description: Your actual inventory in a compact three-row panel.

name: Compass

name: Biome
description: Registry name of the biome at your current position.

name: World Clock
description: World time of day and current day number.

name: Item Counter
description: Count a selected resource in your inventory and offhand.

name: Keystrokes
description: Live movement, jump and mouse-button states.

name: Target Distance
description: Measured camera distance to the current raycast hit.

description: Shader materials on actual living models, with separate visible and occluded colors.

name: Bedrock Void ESP
description: Finds known air openings in the world's lowest layer beside received bedrock.

name: Beehive ESP
description: Shows received beehives and bee nests at the selected honey level.

name: Block Notifier
description: Highlights selected valuable blocks, workstations or storage in received chunks.

name: Covered Hole ESP
description: Finds a solid cover above a bounded, enclosed vertical shaft; natural formations can match.

name: Deepslate ESP
description: Highlights deepslate by type and height; high blocks are a clue rather than placement proof.

name: Dripstone ESP
description: Marks supported pointed-dripstone columns up to 32 blocks long.

name: Hole / Tunnel / Stairs ESP
description: Recognizes bounded shafts, enclosed corridors and rising passage patterns in loaded terrain.

name: Light ESP
description: Highlights received emitted block light; sunlight is excluded and source mode avoids propagated-light clutter.

name: 1 x 1 Holes
description: Finds one-cell pockets with a solid floor and four walls; matching terrain may be natural.

description: Highlights received pistons and piston heads, optionally only extended mechanisms.

description: Shows raw deepslate with an actual horizontal axis; axisless decorative blocks are excluded.

description: Marks received spawner blocks without claiming hidden contents, activation or server data access.

name: Sweet Berry ESP
description: Shows berry bushes from their actual received growth age.

description: Shows bounded vine columns, optionally requiring an observed solid block below their base.

name: Collectible ESP
description: Mark loaded item frames, armor stands and placed banners; contents stay server-controlled.

name: Drowned Trident ESP
description: Mark received drowned actually holding a trident in either hand; drops are not guaranteed.

name: Invisible ESP
description: Mark received invisible players and mobs without altering their visibility or inventory.

name: Llama ESP
description: Mark loaded llamas, optionally including trader llamas.

name: Pillager ESP
description: Mark loaded pillagers with independent debug outlines.

name: Skeleton ESP
description: Draw animated bones from the real posed biped model for selected players and mobs.

name: Villager ESP
description: Mark loaded villagers, optionally including zombie villagers.

name: Wandering Trader ESP
description: Mark received wandering traders; no unreceived entities or trade data are inferred.

name: Advanced Stash Finder
description: Records received storage clusters by chunk, with actual counts and local history.

name: Chunk Finder
description: Shows explainable building and farm evidence in received chunks; candidates can be natural.

name: Kelp ESP
description: Marks tall kelp distributions near a selected top height; this is a pattern, not proof of a farm.

name: Region Map
description: Original coordinate grid of your position and locally recorded stashes; no assumed server region IDs.

name: Place Animation
description: Ease a colored block ghost into each successful placement.

name: Trails
